name: brdcomp-breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: A hierarchical navigation trail with clickable ancestor links. Use the composable `Breadcrumb*` components or the `Breadcrumbs` items array; optional separators and ellipsis are available.

examples.title: Navigation trail
examples.code:
import { Breadcrumbs } from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb"

<Breadcrumbs items={[
  { text: "Home", href: "/" },
  { text: "Docs", href: "/docs" },
  { text: "Current" },
]} />
